title: Keep the audit log's type names when a constant gets a body

cases.says: a constant without a body and a record are shown with the simple name of their type
two constants of one plain enum, or two records of one class, are the same type; values of different types are not
an edit between two plain constants is written with the enum's name, and a change of type is written as such
a constant that overrides a method in a body of its own is shown with its enum's name, not a blank
a constant with a body is the same type as the other constants of its enum, with or without bodies, and not the same type as another enum's constant

origin.section: A Constant With a Body Is an Anonymous Subclass, So getClass() Isn't the Enum
